meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 给已装好的 Dial 通道再加第二个或第三个电话号码。一个 NanoClaw 安装可同时在多个号码上接 SMS 和 AI 语音通话,每个号码是独立的线程化线路,回复从收到消息的那个号码发出。
howto.when: 当 Dial 通道已安装、你想再给代理加一个号码(比如个人线加客服线)时触发;若 Dial 还没装,需先运行 /add-dial。

say.text: 给已有的 Dial 通道再加一个号码 +14155550123
say.note: 会先列出账号现有号码供你选择

say.text: 把这个新号码接到客服那个 agent 组上
say.note: 创建线程化消息组并完成绑定

say.text: 这条线设为 public,谁都能发消息进来
say.note: 只影响这条新线,已有线路不变

howto.what_en: Adds a second or third phone number to an already-installed Dial channel. One install then answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers, each a separate threaded line replying from the number that received the message.
howto.when_en: Use when the Dial channel is already installed and you want to add another number for the agent, such as a personal line plus a support line. If Dial isn't installed, run /add-dial first.

say_en.text: Add another Dial number to my existing line
say_en.note: Lists the account's current numbers first

say_en.text: Wire the new number to the support agent group
say_en.note: Creates the threaded group and the wiring

say_en.text: Make this line public so anyone can text it
say_en.note: Affects only this new line's access policy
